name: LNG carriers (membrane and Moss tanks, reliquefaction)
aliases: LNG carriers (membrane and Moss tanks, reliquefaction)
principle: Ships carry LNG at about -163 °C in membrane tanks (GTT Mark III with 1.2 mm stainless steel, or NO96 invar) or in spherical Moss tanks. Modern ships are about 170,000 m³, Q-Max up to 266,000 m³, and boil-off is about 0.1 to 0.25% of cargo per day, which reliquefaction plants can return to the tanks.

process_steps.name: Voyage with boil-off managed as fuel or reliquefied
